Head reload follows, then original extras map/fill/check/publish yields decode cache912 before first Verifier. Finish remapping alone does not make readers ready. General publish rejects an active lease. Failed begin/finish/restore/refill/head callbacks poison existing cycle and caller phase_fatal exits without owner unwind.
